duality_group.name: duality_group
duality_group.value: SL2Z_tau x SL2Z_rho, exchange tau<->rho, (tau,rho)->(-conj tau,-conj rho); formal group (kernel (+-1,+-1) order 4 not divided out)

narain_convention.name: narain_convention
narain_convention.why: standard convention (FROM MEMORY); root counts of the enhanced algebra are convention independent up to the exchange of L/R and tau<->rho

search_bound_N.name: search_bound_N
search_bound_N.why: entries of SL2Z matrices searched in [-N,N]

H2_A_equals_U3.name: H2_A_equals_U3
H2_A_equals_U3.value: H^2(A,Z)=Lambda^2 H^1(A,Z) with wedge pairing (computed, signature (3,3), even unimodular)

rank4_root_lattices.name: rank4_root_lattices
rank4_root_lattices.why: standard root lattices given in task

complex_structure_J_equals_g.name: complex_structure_J_equals_g
complex_structure_J_equals_g.value: complex structure on R^4/L chosen so that the automorphism g acts as i (g^2=-1) or omega (g^2+g+1=0)
complex_structure_J_equals_g.why: 'compatible with an automorphism of order 3 or 4'; other J commuting with g (a continuous family for order 3) are NOT enumerated

QR_golay_construction.name: QR_golay_construction
QR_golay_construction.value: extended QR code mod 23 built from shifts of an indicator of Q, N, Q+0, N+0 with all-ones; the variant with dim 12, 759 octads and PSL(2,23)-invariance is used (tested, not typed)

delta_search_family.name: delta_search_family
delta_search_family.why: search space for the extra M24 generator; the solution is returned by the scan

Aut_G24_is_M24.name: Aut_G24_is_M24
Aut_G24_is_M24.value: Aut(G24)=M24 of order 244823040 (used only to say the generated group IS the automorphism group; we compute its order and check it preserves G24, not that it is the full automorphism group)

Lefschetz_fixed_point_formula.name: Lefschetz_fixed_point_formula
Lefschetz_fixed_point_formula.value: for a finite-order automorphism with isolated fixed points, #Fix = sum (-1)^k tr(g|H^k)

Km_cohomology.name: Km_cohomology
Km_cohomology.value: H^2(Km A) = pi_* H^2(A) (rank 6, translations act trivially) + 16 exceptional curves E_p permuted as p->p+t; H^1=H^3=0
Km_cohomology.why: standard structure of the Kummer surface

hol_tangent_eigenvalues_distinct_at_node.name: hol_tangent_eigenvalues_distinct_at_nodes
hol_tangent_eigenvalues_distinct_at_node.value: for the chosen symplectic (M,t) the holomorphic tangent eigenvalues (lambda, lambda^-1) are distinct, so g has 2 fixed points on each fixed exceptional curve
hol_tangent_eigenvalues_distinct_at_node.why: true for (i,-i),(omega,omega^2),(tau,tau^-1) since lambda^2 != 1; for translations there are no fixed nodes

Nikulin_fixed_points.name: Nikulin_fixed_points
Nikulin_fixed_points.value: symplectic automorphisms of K3 of order 2,3,4,5,6,7,8 have 8,6,4,4,2,3,2 fixed points
Nikulin_fixed_points.why: FROM MEMORY; used only as an 'expected' comparison, filled after computing

identification_H*(Km)_with_24_points.name: identification_H*(Km)_with_24_points
identification_H*(Km)_with_24_points.value: identify the 24 = rank H^*(K3) with the 24 permuted points of M24
identification_H*(Km)_with_24_points.why: conjectural identification asked for in item 5
